quote: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

activation.condition: the driver backs a vehicle into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner

obligation.description: do not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner

timing.description: the complete vehicle body must enter the selected prohibited region while backing is active; separate earlier backing and later forward movement do not establish this event

parameter_refs.name: reverse_stop_target
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: authored route target before or over the crosswalk

parameter_refs.name: crosswalk_body_overlap
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: observed complete-body polygon overlap while Native reverse is active
